versions.subject: New Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'cmd'
        - '/c'
        - 'assoc'
        - 'exefile'
filter:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.exe=exefile'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: CommandLine="*cmd*" CommandLine="*/c*" CommandLine="*assoc*" CommandLine="*exefile*" NOT CommandLine="*.exe=exefile*"

condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: feat: update cmd based rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'Cmd.Exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'assoc '
        - 'exefile'
filter:
    CommandLine|contains: '.exe=exefile'
condition: all of selection_* and not filter
versions.spl: Image="*\\cmd.exe" OR OriginalFileName="Cmd.Exe" CommandLine="*assoc *" CommandLine="*exefile*" NOT CommandLine="*.exe=exefile*"
